description: Podiums announced by the SAT Competition and SAT Race organizers (results pages, slides and reports), restricted to the tracks whose solvers are in this repository. Ties share a rank. When the organizers list several entries of one team in a medal cell, only the best-scoring one is recorded and the others are named in its note. Entries with a null solver are podiums whose solver is not in the repository set of that year. Corrections welcome.
